title: OARI Program Director
statement: West Oakland's launch meets crisis with care exactly where it's needed most—our teams are now live in District 1 with bilingual responders covering evening and weekend hours to match when behavioral health calls peak in this community. Fruitvale and D5 implementations will follow this evidence-based deployment model.
action: Finalizing D3 and D5 launch timelines based on D1's operational data
numberMoved: 12 teams now active in West Oakland
